description: Standard defense layers applied in the LLM security playground's protected mode.

defense_layers.name: Input Analysis
defense_layers.description: Screens user input for instruction-override patterns, privilege-escalation phrases and marker strings before the input reaches the model.

defense_layers.name: Context Separation
defense_layers.description: Encapsulates system and developer instructions as trusted, and marks user content and retrieved documents as untrusted with clear delimiters.

defense_layers.name: Output Filtering
defense_layers.description: Scans generated responses for leaked secrets or policy-violating content and sanitizes or blocks them.

defense_layers.name: Security Policy Layer
defense_layers.description: Enforces developer-defined invariants (e.g. never disclose secrets) as a separate check independent of the base prompt.
